_meta.about: First batch of 50 product domains across the 12 policy categories, weighted to the industries of Chennai, Coimbatore, Tiruppur, Madurai and Tiruchirappalli. District fit: 3 = a cluster the product serves directly, 2 = strong local demand or supply, missing = no particular local advantage. Risk levels 1 (low) to 3 (high) are typical for the domain, before the founder's own situation adjusts them.
_meta.serves: Categories whose businesses use this product. A domain can only be a hybrid partner to domains in the categories it serves; consumer products serve none.
